blocks.text: Doug Kramer urged his social media followers to promote love and compassion over hate and resentment, also encouraging them to forgive “generously.” In a message shared through his Instagram page on Friday, Oct. 2, Doug wrote, “Fight hate with Love. Resentment with Light. Cruelty is an echo of unrest within. Yet not every stone thrown is purely blind.” “Perfection isn’t human; we all stumble along the way. Grace is needed both ways—we all hurt others, and we also feel pain. So extend forgiveness generously; none of us walk with clean hands,” he continued. “Hold fast to your warmth and keep moving […]...
